Okay, there's a lot to unpack here First of all, I am an advocate of simple rule when it comes to the relationships You should be in a relationship that feels simple easygoing and where your partner is the best person for you If you already want to cheat, then why are you even in this relationship be honest with yourself break up go explore What's out there and despite how cliche it sounds when you eventually meet the right person you would not want to cheat Second guys don't talk about sleeping with other women to your girlfriend. That's disrespectful to her Imagine the roles would reverse and your girlfriend would tell you that even though she's in a relationship with you She wants to sleep with another man. How would you feel exactly use some logic here that kind of talk only hurts your partner Third even if she says it's okay. Don't fool yourself. Don't be surprised when the relationship falls apart So from every angle this is a bad idea Honestly, you both sound quite inexperienced when it comes to relationships the best move here be straight with yourself Say thank you and it go explore your fantasies gain some life experience and eventually find someone you can actually build a healthy relationship With that will be better for you and better for her, too
